definition.simple: The money value of a one-point move in a futures price, for one contract.
definition.balanced: [[notional-value|Notional value]] = price × multiplier. Some contracts give a [[contract-size]] in units instead; the idea is the same. Multipliers differ between contracts, so take the number from the exact contract's specification.

example: Fictional: multiplier 10 USD per point. A 15-point move = 15 × 10 = 150 USD per contract.
